concept: PCIe Protocol Tunneling and Thunderbolt Retimer Jitter
summary: Source-anchored research for PCIe Protocol Tunneling and Thunderbolt Retimer Jitter. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: PCIe protocol tunneling encapsulates Transaction Layer Packets (TLPs) into transport frames, incurring packet assembly and disassembly overhead at host and device controllers. (high confidence)

Retimer jitter and transport layer flow control credits cause non-deterministic round-trip DMA completion times, necessitating large contiguous transfers rather than layer-by-layer handshakes. (high confidence)
